summary: Glamsterdam 兼容性问题又多了一条解法：Versioned Opcodes 草案让新合约用带新 gas 表的 V2 操作码，旧合约保持旧 gas 表，V2 去掉 GAS 等 gas 自省操作码。EF 更新博客：已收到 4 份会被打破的已部署合约报告，建议 ACD 等审计结果公开后再决定改规范或定 Hoodi 时间，并公布 11-12 到 11-19 的时间表。Barnabé 表示 Ethlabs 支持后量子用户账户工作，Ben Edgington 介绍 PQDC。

items.title: EIPs PR #12638：Add EIP: Versioned Opcodes for Gas Repricing
items.note: 02:40 提交。新合约必须使用 V2 操作码集，按 EIP-8037/8038 的新 gas 表计费；已部署合约保持旧 gas 表；`DELEGATECALL_V2` 要求目标也是 V2；V2 中去掉 gas 自省操作码 `GAS` 和 `GASLIMIT`。讨论来自 Leo Glisic 的推文。
items.title_en: EIPs PR #12638: Add EIP: Versioned Opcodes for Gas Repricing
items.note_en: Opened at 02:40. New contracts must use the V2 opcode set, charged by the new EIP-8037/8038 gas schedule; deployed contracts keep the legacy schedule; `DELEGATECALL_V2` requires the target to be V2 as well; and the gas introspection opcodes `GAS` and `GASLIMIT` are left out of V2. The discussion started from Leo Glisic's post.

items.title: EF 博客 11-09 更新：Glamsterdam 的 gas 改动与已部署合约
items.note: 周五发文后收到 4 份报告，指出部署中的合约可能在 EIP-8037/8038 下出问题，EF 正在逐一审查并联系受影响协议。也听到更广的担忧：影响不可变合约的改动没有得到足够审视。EF 建议 ACD 等审计结果公开、留出审阅时间，再决定是否修改规范或何时安排 Hoodi 升级；已在原型化几种修订方案，并记录每种方案解决什么问题、又会打破哪些其他不变量，11-19 ACDE 上展示。
items.title_en: EF Blog update of 11-09: Glamsterdam gas changes and deployed contracts
items.note_en: Since Friday's post the EF has received 4 reports pointing to deployed contracts that could break under EIP-8037/8038, and it is reviewing each one and contacting the protocols that may be affected. It has also heard a broader concern that changes affecting immutable contracts are not getting the scrutiny they deserve. The EF recommends that ACD wait until the audit findings are public and there has been time to review them before deciding whether to revise the specs or when to schedule the Hoodi upgrade. Several possible revisions are already being prototyped, with notes on which problems each solves and which other invariants it would break, to be presented at ACDE on 11-19.

items.title: Magicians：检查已部署合约是否仍运行审计过的 commit
items.note: 15:43。浏览器的“已验证”标记只说明某份源码能编译出该地址的代码，不说明来自哪个 commit；对代理合约则完全不说明逻辑合约。怎么用：用相同的 solc 版本、optimizer runs、viaIR、evmVersion 重建审计 commit，对比运行时字节码。
items.title_en: Magicians: checking that a deployed contract still runs the audited commit
items.note_en: 15:43. An explorer's "verified" badge only shows that some source compiles to the code at an address, not which commit it came from, and for a proxy it says nothing about the logic contract. How to do it: rebuild the audited commit with the same solc version, optimizer runs, viaIR and evmVersion, and compare the runtime bytecode.

items.title_en: Magicians: who can upgrade 7 tokenized treasury and gold tokens
items.note_en: 10:47. A read-only onchain snapshot as of 11-09: for 3 tokens the upgrade owner is a single EOA with no onchain delay, 2 use a 4-of-7 Safe, 1 an older 3-of-6 multisig, and 1 has a 24-hour timelock. The author stresses this does not mean the assets are at risk.

summary_en: Another answer to Glamsterdam compatibility: the Versioned Opcodes draft has new contracts use V2 opcodes that carry the new gas schedule, while old contracts keep the old one, and V2 drops gas introspection opcodes such as GAS. The EF updated its blog post: it has received 4 reports of deployed contracts that could break, recommends that ACD wait until the audit results are public before deciding whether to change the specs or schedule Hoodi, and published a timeline from 11-12 to 11-19. Barnabé said Ethlabs supports work on post-quantum user accounts, and Ben Edgington explained PQDC.
